hypotheses.name: z-fix moves Sybil's score materially
hypotheses.statistic: share of T5 exams with |lbar6(zfix) - lbar6(main)| >= 0.25 x sd_ref_lbar6_all_dev_main
hypotheses.population: T5: test z-fix variants with spacing/thickness <= 0.65 (all screens)
hypotheses.test: one-sided Wald, participant-bootstrap SE (2,000 draws, seed 0)

hypotheses.name: z-fix changes the tau90 flag
hypotheses.statistic: share of T5 exams with [s1(main) >= tau90_s1] != [s1(zfix) >= tau90_s1]

hypotheses.name: kernel change rarely changes the tau90 flag
hypotheses.statistic: share of T4 pairs with [s1(sharp) >= tau90_s1] != [s1(soft) >= tau90_s1]
hypotheses.population: T4: the 500 soft-kernel partners of T1 exams (and their main series)

hypotheses.name: technical-named features carry a part of Sybil's score
hypotheses.statistic: Cov(G_T, lbar1) / Var(lbar1): share of the variance of lbar1 carried by the 6 T-named raw-unit families (frozen dictionary, frozen labels)
hypotheses.population: all scored test main exams (T1, T2, T3)
hypotheses.source: Q1b group shares (protocol 9.2, 9.7); feature-based (valid arm: raw units)

bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile; p from the Wald statistic (est - null) / SD of the draws

fallbacks: if T3 is not scored, H1 to H3 use the T5 rows of T1 and T2, and H5 uses T1 and T2 exams (stated before the run)
if T4 is not scored, H4 is 'not evaluated' and counts as not confirmed
if T5 is not scored, H1 to H3 are 'not evaluated' and count as not confirmed
secondary: AUROC (participant bootstrap) of Sybil s1 (y1, all screens), s6 (y6, baseline), F1, F6, R-size, F+I (frozen parameters)
frozen A3 combination: (F+I + Sybil) minus F+I, y1 and y6
frozen U3 table: false alarms per 1,000 at the radiologists' test sensitivity for the call, Sybil, F, C, F+I
descriptive: z-fix and kernel statistics by stretch class, lung cut and maker; group shares of all terms
